featured_reviews.name: VINODKUMAR R
featured_reviews.review_text: One of the best working women's hostels in Mumbai! Very safe, clean, and well-managed with excellent vegetarian food. It's extremely hard to get a room—even 3 months' advance booking may not be enough, and a local guardian (Mumbai resident) is required. Rooms are assigned (not selectable) and come in single (A type) or shared (B & C types), all with attached bathrooms. Rent is based on your salary and much cheaper than PGs. Located just 400 meters from Bandra Colony Metro (Aqua Line 3), it’s only 15 mins to BKC. Staff are very cordial. You need documents like Aadhaar, PAN, job offer letter, character and health certificates, and your local guardian’s ID. If you get a room here, consider yourself lucky!

Staying at WiSH has honestly been one of the best decisions during my college journey. Moving away from home was scary at first, but WiSH never made me feel alone. The environment here is very safe, positive, and homely, which makes it so comfortable for students.

The rooms are well-maintained, hygiene is properly taken care of, and the food genuinely feels homemade. It’s very rare to find a place where you feel both comfortable and cared for at the same time.

A special thank you to Shailee di and Aarti Ji for always supporting me throughout my journey at WiSH. Whether it was during difficult days, studies, health issues, or just emotional support, they were always there with understanding and care. Their warmth and guidance made this place feel more like family than just a hostel.

What I love most about WiSH is that every student is treated with genuine care and attention. It truly feels like a second home, and I will always be grateful for the memories, comfort, and support I received here.

featured_reviews.name: Alan K M
featured_reviews.review_text:
⭐ 5 Stars of Disgrace – Seva Niketan

This is by far the worst place I have ever stayed. The staff openly smoke, drink, and use weed in areas where they know there are no cameras. Rooms are never cleaned — they’re filthy, unhygienic, and the beds are infested with bed bugs.

The lady at the front desk seems more interested in picking fights than helping guests. They allow cops and GST officers to walk in at any hour, but paying guests are locked out if they return late. Even after taking your money, they won’t open the gate or show basic courtesy.

The bathrooms are always clogged and dirty, and the canteen is outright disgusting — you can see rats running around the kitchen. It’s shocking that a place run under Christian management treats guests with such disrespect and neglect.

To make things worse, they refuse to provide any proper proof of payment — no bills, no receipts, nothing.

A completely mismanaged, unhygienic, and unsafe place. Stay away.

featured_reviews.name: Siddharth
featured_reviews.review_text: A well managed budget hostel, which is clean and perfect for short stays. The rooms are big. Only Individual rooms are available with charging points. Clean R.O water in each floor. An upgraded canteen with humble staff. Overall a good experience. Washrooms are shared, but cleaned very well.

featured_reviews.review_text: Location is good but the place is disappointing, u can't sleep here at night as bed bugs will come to talk to you, toilets also smelly , canteen food not good and the staff thinks themselves as they work in a five star hotel

featured_reviews.name: BubbleAisle
featured_reviews.review_text:
I usually don’t leave reviews, but I feel compelled to share my disappointing experience. First off, the customer service was incredibly lacking. The staff seemed uninterested and unhelpful, which made the entire experience feel very uncomfortable. I waited much longer than expected for my order, and when it finally arrived, it was cold and not at all what I had asked for.

The ambiance was nothing to write home about either. The place was poorly lit, and the decor felt outdated and drab. To make matters worse, the bathroom was dirty, and the overall cleanliness of the restaurant was far below acceptable standards.

I also found the pricing to be absurd for the quality of food and service I received. It’s clear that this place is not focused on its customers, and I won’t be returning. Definitely not worth the hype.
